edges.reason: transfer() invokes _transfer with msg.sender as the from address
transferFrom() invokes _transfer then reduces allowance
approve() delegates to internal _approve
_transfer ends by calling _tokenTransfer
_transfer conditionally calls swapTokensForEth on contract token balance when swapEnabled, making an external call during a transfer
_transfer conditionally calls sendETHToFee to push ETH out during a transfer
swapTokensForEth performs an external router swap call
sendETHToFee performs an external ETH transfer to the fee wallet
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferStandard
_transferStandard requests value breakdown from _getValues
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee
_getValues calls _getTValues
_getValues calls _getRate
_getValues calls _getRValues
_getRate calls _getCurrentSupply
tokenFromReflection calls _getRate
openTrading calls factory createPair and addLiquidityETH externally
openTrading approves the router for max uint on the pair token
manualswap triggers the external router swap path
manualsend triggers the external ETH transfer path
msg.sender is compared to _feeAddrWallet1 in KillBot, but the blacklist state variable is gated on that hardcoded wallet
msg.sender must equal _feeAddrWallet1 to unblacklist in ReviveAddress
msg.sender must equal _feeAddrWallet1 to trigger manualswap
msg.sender must equal _feeAddrWallet1 to trigger manualsend
msg.sender flows into the from parameter and fee/cooldown logic of _transfer
msg.sender is passed as the owner argument into _approve via approve
block.timestamp gates the cooldown[to] check and write in _transfer, creating timestamp dependency
block.timestamp is used as the router swap deadline, creating timestamp dependency
block.timestamp is used as the addLiquidityETH deadline in openTrading
_feeAddrWallet1 is the destination of the ETH transfer in sendETHToFee
_maxTxAmount caps the transfer amount inside the cooldown branch of _transfer
bots[from] blacklist flag gates _transfer execution
cooldownEnabled gates the cooldown/max tx checks in _transfer
swapEnabled gates the automatic swap and ETH payout in _transfer
cooldown[to] is read and written using block.timestamp in _transfer
inSwap flag acts as the lockTheSwap guard around the external swap call
_feeAddr1 is supplied to _getValues as the tax fee
_feeAddr2 is supplied to _getValues as the team fee
_rTotal feeds the rSupply used to compute the rate
_rOwned balances are read and written during _transferStandard
liftMaxTx writes the _maxTxAmount state variable
setCooldownEnabled writes the cooldownEnabled state variable
KillBot writes bots[_address] to true
ReviveAddress writes bots[notbot] to false
renounceOwnership sets _owner to the zero address, disabling onlyOwner control
openTrading assigns the router address to uniswapV2Router
openTrading assigns the created pair to uniswapV2Pair
The external ETH transfer is executed inside the _transfer flow, so a malicious fee recipient contract could re-enter _transfer before state finalization
The external router swap call can hand control to the router/pair, allowing re-entry into contract logic if the lockTheSwap guard is bypassed through manualswap
addLiquidityETH and createPair are external calls made from openTrading, giving external contracts control flow before tradingOpen is set

normalization_plan.reason: from is only the address parameter consumed by _transfer's blacklist, cooldown and fee logic
to is only the recipient parameter used for cooldown and pair-address checks in _transfer
amount is only the transfer amount validated against _maxTxAmount in _transfer
sender is the source address parameter passed from transferFrom into _transfer
recipient is the destination address parameter of transferFrom
amount is the transfer amount parameter of transferFrom checked against allowance
_address is the blacklist target parameter of KillBot
notbot is the unblacklist target parameter of ReviveAddress
tokenAmount is the amount forwarded to the external router swap call
onoff is the boolean parameter written into cooldownEnabled by setCooldownEnabled
tAmount is the transfer amount parameter consumed by _transferStandard
rAmount is the reflection amount parameter validated and converted in tokenFromReflection
spender is the allowance spender parameter of approve
contractTokenBalance is a local cache of balanceOf(address(this)) used only inside _transfer
contractETHBalance is a local read of the contract ETH balance used in _transfer
currentRate is the local rate used only inside tokenFromReflection
contractBalance is a local balance used only inside manualswap
contractETHBalance is a local balance used only inside manualsend
path is the local swap path array built solely for the external router swap call
